jobs.title: AI Trainer (Earth and Environmental Sciences)
jobs.description:
The work

• Create realistic computational Earth and environmental science tasks that challenge advanced AI models.
• Write task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria.
• Review AI-generated code, geospatial analyses, simulations, forecasts, and other technical outputs.
• Identify problems involving coordinate systems, spatial or temporal data, model assumptions, uncertainty, numerical methods, and reproducibility.
• Validate computational results against observations, measurements, or established models.

Requirements

• How pay works: You are paid for each task you submit that the project accepts. The hiring company estimates this comes to $60–$120 an hour. What you earn depends on how many tasks you finish and how many are accepted.
• $60 to $120 per hour equivalent, paid per task that meets the project specifications.
• Fully remote contractor work with a flexible schedule and less than 20 hours per week.
• Task availability and completion time may vary.
• Professional fluency in English.
• Intermediate experience level with prior paid experience training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems on scientific or technical tasks.
• Strong practical proficiency in Python.
• Deep expertise in at least 1 Earth or environmental science specialization.
• Hands-on experience with geospatial analysis, modeling, simulation, forecasting, remote sensing, statistics, or reproducible research.
• Ability to set clear standards for technically correct solutions and assess technical submissions.
• Relevant areas include geoscience, geology, geophysics, atmosphere and climate, meteorology, ocean and marine science, hydrology, remote sensing, environmental science, and sustainability.
• Useful tools include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, xarray, GeoPandas, GDAL, rasterio, NetCDF, or comparable tools.
• Experience creating AI-training tasks, reference answers, rubrics, graders, or benchmark problems is valuable.
• Publications, preprints, open-source scientific software, datasets, models, notebooks, maps, simulations, or research profiles can demonstrate relevant work.

Experience: Intermediate level
Skills: Earth & Environmental Sciences, AI Training, Programming Skills

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
Company Description
Nafeesa Online Quran Education Hub is a digital learning platform dedicated to providing accessible, high-quality Quran education to learners worldwide. The hub focuses on structured, curriculum-based teaching that supports learners at various levels of proficiency. Using online tools and resources, the organization aims to create a supportive and flexible environment for both students and educators. Team members collaborate remotely to develop content, improve learning materials, and enhance the overall online learning experience.
Role Description
This full-time remote Research Assistant role supports the continuous improvement of educational content and teaching methods at Nafeesa Online Quran Education Hub. Day-to-day tasks include conducting qualitative and quantitative research on online education practices, analyzing learner performance data, and preparing clear reports and summaries for educators and management. The Research Assistant will help design surveys and feedback tools, organize and interpret data sets, and contribute to evidence-based recommendations to enhance curriculum and student engagement. The role also involves collaborating with teaching staff, maintaining accurate research documentation, and assisting with the development of new learning resources and initiatives.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Data Analysis abilities to interpret educational metrics and research findings.
Candidates should possess solid Research skills, including designing studies, collecting data, and reviewing literature relevant to online and Quran education.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present insights clearly in written reports and verbal discussions with remote team members.
Candidates should possess Laboratory Skills or equivalent practical research skills where applicable, such as using digital tools for data collection and organization.
Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Education, Social Sciences, Data Science, Islamic Studies, or a related field are beneficial.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and handle multiple research tasks simultaneously.
Familiarity with online learning platforms, basic statistical tools or software, and an interest in Quran education and pedagogy is advantageous.

Entry level

Employment type
